chapter_meta_description: Han Li reaches Nanming Island to restock supplies for the Outer Star Seas, only to witness a massive Rebel Alliance assault on the harbor. Classic Mortal Stream tension and strategy.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 509: The Art of Not Fighting
og_description: Han Li reaches Nanming Island to restock supplies, but a thousand-cultivator battle erupts. He chooses the smartest option: hide and watch.
twitter_title: RMJI 509: Han Li watches a war from the shadows. Peak Mortal Stream.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Han Li join the fight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, survival is the only metric. Han Li calculates that the risk of exposure to a Nascent Soul cultivator far outweighs any possible gain. He hides because it is the most rational decision.
It's an ingredient in the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng formula. The shopkeeper suspects it's an ancient name for a modern spiritual herb that has since been renamed.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li so focused on stockpiling supplies?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the xianxia world, running out of common alchemical ingredients can halt cultivation for years. Han Li treats resource logistics as seriously as combat tactics.
